fields.description: BRD C.1.4 leaves the dealer-classification measurement period/rolling window an open point (bands themselves are confirmed) — this is the configurable placeholder recompute_dealer_classifications() reads until Pacific confirms the real window.
fields.label: Dealer Classification Window (Days)

fields.description: BRD C.11 trigger #4 (BRD C.7.3: "any transaction-level price or discount change — even a one-rupee change — is an override requiring approval") is Pacific's own rule: default 0 means ANY discount at all is audit-locked, no threshold. This app is white-labeled — a different client may want a looser rule (e.g. discounts up to 5% auto-apply, only above that needs Management approval). approvals.api.gate_discount_over_price_list reads this per-site, so that's a config change, not a code change, per deployment.
fields.label: Discount Approval Threshold %
